items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: My oldest brother used to play bass drum.

ctx.x: Oh do you remember some more members of that band? Who were the drummers? Did they use the bass and snare drum? How many drummers would they use?
My oldest brother used to play bass drum. Oh he did? Yeah.
They had another snare drummer too?
